title: 第9章  会长的亲自邀请第10章  傲娇阿姨龙疏寒
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
面对突然抛来的橄榄枝，夜离殇稍微愣了一下，但还未等她回答，云朔就继续开口。
“你不用急着给出回答。”
“你的天赋非常好，无论什么时候，只要你想加入御兽师协会，协会的大门都会为你敞开。”
“而且加入御兽师协会后，对你而言是百利而无一害的事情，以你的天赋，加入协会后，协会的高层肯定会为你倾斜资源的。”
“例如：高品质的御兽蛋或是高品质的妖兽，市面上几乎不流通的稀有材料，提高自身精神力的方法，和御兽师协会的保护。”
“这些对你都是有帮助的，而且御兽师协会暂时也不需要你做什么，你该上学就上学，该考顶尖学府就考顶尖学府，等你从顶尖学府毕业后，在御兽师协会中的地位，应该不会比现在的我低。”
“甚至未来成为协会的十二席之一，也是完全有可能的。”
云朔面带笑容地看着夜离殇。
听着云朔的话语，夜离殇轻轻眨了眨眼睛，宛如宝石般的眼眸中露出思索的神色。
加入御兽师协会的好处很诱人，就犹如云朔所说的那样百利而无一害，让夜离殇感觉很是心动。
虽然夜离殇手里有一张她妈妈留下的卡，平时开销完全够用，属于有点小钱的程度，但市面上不怎么流通的稀有材料，和培育御兽所需要的一些罕见材料，可不仅仅只是用钱能买的。
所以无论是御兽师协会的资源倾斜，亦或是各自稀有材料的获取，对于夜离殇的吸引力都非常大，就更别说御兽师协会的保护。
御兽师协会的影响力，在神州境内仅次于神州官方而已，故而御兽师协会提供的保护，就等于是为安全提供了一层保障。
但就在夜离殇准备答应的时候，一段尘封已久的记忆悄然浮现在她的脑海，将她的思绪拉到年幼的时候。
“离殇，妈妈教你一些战斗技巧，咱们不主动欺负人，但也不能被人欺负。”
“还有，你以后若是成为一名御兽师的话，当一名自由的御兽师会是一个不错的选择，我当初离开御兽师协会的时候，可是费了很大的功夫呢。”
夜梦璃曾经所说的话语，在夜离殇的脑海中逐渐浮现，而这也让夜离殇刚到嘴边的话转了个弯。
“云叔叔，加入御兽师协会的事情，我个人是非常心动的，也很想同意下来，但加入御兽师协会不是一件小事，所以我需要询问一下家中长辈的意思，然后再做决定。”
夜离殇低着头，轻轻捏着云绒狐的小耳朵，语气很是认真。
“嗯，这是应该的。”

“加入御兽师协会不是小事，理应先跟家中长辈说一声，看看长辈们的意思。”
“离殇，这是我的联系方式，你记一下，有什么事情，或是需要什么帮助，你直接联系我就行。”
云朔笑了笑，将自己联系方式告知夜离殇。
夜离殇从口袋中拿出手机，将云朔的联系方式给记了下来。
“云叔叔，我家中还有些事情，就先回去了。”
夜离殇露出一个礼貌的笑容。
“嗯，路上小心，遇到什么无法处理的事情，直接联系我就行。”
云朔点点头，目送着夜离殇离开。
直到夜离殇的身影在视线尽头消失，云朔才从座位上起身，来到落地窗前，静静注视着繁华街道。
“夜有归时，骨有回响。”
“十七岁，十七年前，那可是御兽界最不平静的一年，各种大事频发，你是和那几位中哪一位有关系，还是说只是一个巧合呢。”
云朔喃喃自语着，眼眸逐渐深邃起来。
……
而在另一边。
刚刚走出御兽师协会的夜离殇，脚步微不可察地停顿了一下，目光往云朔所在的楼层看了一眼。
“抱歉啦，云叔叔。”
“加入御兽师协会的事情，你应该是等不到结果了。”
content_en:
Faced with the sudden olive branch, Ye Lishang was stunned for a moment, but before she could answer, Yun Shuo continued to speak.
"You don't have to rush into an answer."
"Your talent is very good. Whenever you want to join the Beast Masters Association, the door of the association will be open for you."
"Furthermore, joining the Beast Masters Association will be a completely beneficial thing for you. With your talent, after joining the association, the top management of the association will definitely allocate resources to you."
"For example: high-quality beast-taming eggs or high-quality monster beasts, rare materials that are almost uncirculated on the market, ways to improve one's own spiritual power, and the protection of the Beast Tamer Association."
"These are all helpful to you, and the Beast Controllers Association doesn't need you to do anything for the time being. If you should go to school, go to school, and if you should go to a top university, go to a top university. When you graduate from a top school, your status in the Beast Controllers Association should not be lower than mine now."
"It is entirely possible to even become one of the twelve seats in the association in the future."
Yun Shuo looked at Ye Li Shang with a smile.
Listening to Yun Shuo's words, Ye Lishang blinked slightly, with a thoughtful look in his jewel-like eyes.
The benefits of joining the Beast Tamer Association are very tempting, just like what Yun Shuo said, there are no harm at all, which makes Ye Li Shang feel very excited.
Although Ye Lishang has a card left by her mother in her hand, which is enough for daily expenses and is a bit of a small amount of money, rare materials that are not widely circulated in the market and some rare materials needed to cultivate beasts can not only be bought with money.
Therefore, whether it is the resource tilt of the Beastmaster Association or the acquisition of their own rare materials, it is very attractive to Ye Lishang, not to mention the protection of the Beastmaster Association.
The influence of the Beast Masters Association is second only to the Chinese officialdom in China, so the protection provided by the Beast Masters Association is equivalent to providing a layer of security.
But just when Ye Lishang was about to agree, a long-dusted memory quietly appeared in her mind, pulling her thoughts back to her childhood.
"Li Shang, mom will teach you some fighting skills. We don't actively bully others, but we can't be bullied either."
"Also, if you become a beast master in the future, being a free beast master would be a good choice. When I left the Beast Master Association, I spent a lot of effort."
The words Ye Mengli once said gradually emerged in Ye Lizhang's mind, and this also made Ye Lizhang's words take a turn when they came to his mouth.
"Uncle Yun, I am personally very excited about joining the Beast Masters Association, and I really want to agree to it, but joining the Beast Masters Association is not a trivial matter, so I need to ask the elders in my family about their intentions before making a decision."
Ye Lishang lowered his head, gently pinched Yunrong Hu's little ears, and spoke in a very serious tone.
"Well, that's as it should be."
"Joining the Beast Masters Association is not a trivial matter. You should first tell the elders in your family and see what they think."
"Li Shang, this is my contact information. Remember it. If you have anything or need any help, just contact me directly."
Yun Shuo smiled and told Ye Li Shang his contact information.
Ye Lishang took out his mobile phone from his pocket and wrote down Yun Shuo's contact information.
"Uncle Yun, I still have some things to do at home, so I'll go back first."
Ye Lishang showed a polite smile.
"Well, be careful on the road. If you encounter anything you can't handle, just contact me directly."
Yun Shuo nodded and watched Ye Li Shang leave.
It wasn't until Ye Li Shang's figure disappeared at the end of his sight that Yun Shuo stood up from his seat, came to the floor-to-ceiling window, and quietly stared at the bustling street.
"When you return at night, your bones will echo."
"Seventeen years old. Seventeen years ago, it was the most unstable year in the beast-controlling world.Such big things happen frequently. Are you related to any of those people, or is it just a coincidence? "
Yun Shuo murmured to himself, his eyes gradually getting darker.
…
And on the other side.
Ye Lishang, who had just walked out of the Beast Tamer Association, paused imperceptibly and glanced at the floor where Yun Shuo was.
"Sorry, Uncle Yun. "
"You can't wait for the result of joining the Beast Masters Association. "
